title: Test Automation Specialist Intern
description:
Are you naturally curious about how technology works? Do you enjoy solving problems, finding bugs, and figuring out why something isn't working as expected? Are you excited to learn new tools and collaborate with others to build high-quality software solutions?

ARAG is looking for a Test Automation Specialist Intern for summer 2027! In this role, you'll help develop and maintain automated test solutions, analyze test results, and support efforts to modernize testing frameworks and applications. A strong attention to detail, technical curiosity, and a passion for continuous learning are essential for success in this position.

Essential Duties And Responsibilities

With guidance, develops, modifies, and executes automated tests using Selenium and C#, including adding new automation code and improving the structure and maintainability of the existing framework.
Reviews automated test results, compares outcomes with previous runs, and identifies, investigates, documents, and escalates failures, regressions, or unexpected variances.
Reviews user stories and acceptance criteria for testability and creates or updates automation to support approved requirements.
Reviews and refactors initialization logic and identifies and removes duplicate, unused, or outdated code.
Supports Salesforce test-automation migration efforts.
May assist with upgrading the Selenium automation framework from SpecFlow to Reqnroll and to newer .NET framework versions.
May help research and configure Outlook on the web to support testing and analysis of emails generated by automated tests.
Collaborates with developers, Product Owners, Scrum Teams, and end users to understand requirements, run test plans and scripts, and communicate progress and findings.
Documents testing activities, code changes, findings, and open questions clearly while following coding standards and maintaining traceability in Azure DevOps or similar tools.
Executes manual testing when requested and tracks and reports identified issues.
Serves as a positive role model by representing ARAG at its Best.
Other duties as assigned.

Qualifications

Knowledge

Understanding of the application development lifecycle and the role of quality assurance throughout planning, development, testing, release, and maintenance.
Basic to intermediate C# programming knowledge and familiarity with Visual Studio.
Exposure to Selenium WebDriver or other automated testing tools.
Basic understanding of .NET and application framework upgrades.
Ability to read, troubleshoot, refactor, and clean up an existing codebase.

Skills

Required

Experience testing web-based applications.
Working knowledge and understanding of fundamental concepts of CI/CD (Continuous Integration/Continuous Delivery), Automated Testing (GUI, database, and service), User Acceptance Testing.
Understanding of object-oriented programming concepts.
Ability to apply foundational C# programming and object-oriented concepts when reviewing, modifying, and troubleshooting code in Visual Studio.
Strong problem-solving and troubleshooting ability.
Attention to detail and the ability to follow coding standards.
Highly organized with ability to effectively manage workload across multiple project teams.
Ability to document work, findings, and questions clearly.
Strong interpersonal skills to foster teamwork, commitment, and cooperation.
Good written and verbal communication skills, including asking thoughtful questions and explaining findings.
Willingness to learn new tools and technologies.
Comfort working with and improving an existing codebase rather than only writing new code.
Ability to effectively operate, multi-task, and remain positive in a fast-paced, ever-changing environment.
Willingness to maintain a “fail fast, move forward” mindset.

Preferred

Interest in test automation, QA processes, and application development.
Exposure to Selenium WebDriver or another test-automation framework.
Familiarity with Azure DevOps or a similar Agile project-management tool.
Familiarity with SpecFlow, Reqnroll, Gherkin, or BDD (behavior driven development) concepts and the use of Gherkin scenarios in test-automation.
Basic knowledge of .NET and framework modernization.
Exposure to Salesforce, LambdaTest/TestMu, and automated testing tools.
Experience with Cucumber and behavior driven development of automated testing, including Gherkin.
Experience with version control systems (Git)
Experience with SQL or an understanding of relational databases is preferred
Knowledge or experience with Load and performance testing.
Experience using AI-assisted coding and test-automation tools, such as Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, or similar platforms.

Education

Must have or must be pursuing a four-year college level education, or equivalent combination of education, experience and formal training in IT or a related field. Must be in good academic standing with applicable college institution.

Experience

Coursework, projects, or practical experience with C#, Visual Studio, object-oriented programming, software testing, application development, or testing methodologies is preferred.

Certifications, Licenses, Associations, etc.

None required.

Physical

Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.
